title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_17635)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the requirements related to the performance and safety of beds for adults for domestic and non-domestic use. 1.2 This standard applies to completely manufactured/fabricated beds. It also applies to ready-to-assemble units; in that case the requirements of this standard shall apply to the assembled units. 1.3 This standard does not cover waterbeds, airbeds, foldaway beds, bunk beds and beds for people with special needs, nor the beds for healthcare and medical purposes.
